description: Failure B — reconcile OmniRoute's advertised 5090 context so the 131072 off-by-one 400 stops. ROOT CAUSE (confirmed from live): the esnixi switcher already serves max-model-len 131072 and advertises max_input=98304, but OmniRoute's model-capability-overrides still carry the stale pre-narrow pair (vllm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4 -> context_length=147456, max_input_tokens=114688; and the balanced variant -> 147456/65536). max_input=114688 + max_output=16384 = exactly 131072 (zero slack), so a 114689-input request passes OmniRoute's check and the real 131072-total backend rejects it ('1 over'). omniroute-routing.py already has layouts={'vllm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4': (131072, 98304)} and applies it as a model-capability-override PATCH when NOT --code-only, but the apply was never run against live and the balanced variant is missing from layouts. Agent edits the generator and re-applies from the Mac. No esnixi rebuild needed.
steps: Over SSH, read home/programs/omniroute-routing.py on celes@192.168.42.254:sources/celesrenata/nix-flakes-refactored (branch feat/nvfp4-reader-fabric) and locate the `layouts = { 'vllm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4': (131072, 98304) }` dict (around line 203) and the override_plan apply block (around lines 231-245).

Add the balanced variant to `layouts`: `'vllm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-balanced': (131072, 65536)` — context_length corrected to 131072 but KEEP max_input_tokens at 65536 (the balanced lane intentionally reserves more output headroom; do NOT raise it to 98304). Confirm the coder entry stays (131072, 98304).
Commit the edit on esnixi branch feat/nvfp4-reader-fabric (do NOT push). Mirror no snapshot (routing.py is not snapshotted).

From the Mac, read the management key by name (cat /run/secrets/omniroute_management_api_key) and run a PREVIEW first: `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY=<mgmt> python3 omniroute-routing.py --base-url https://omniroute.celestium.life` (no --apply) to confirm the printed modelOverrides plan shows the coder going to (131072, 98304) and balanced to (131072, 65536). If the generator requires esnixi-local paths, run it over SSH on esnixi with the mgmt key in the environment instead.

Apply: re-run WITHOUT --code-only and WITH --apply so the model-capability-override PATCH runs. Capture the generator's backup path and 'Applied 5090 layout override' lines into reader-fabric-verification.md.

The same endpoint returns vllm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-balanced context_length=131072 AND max_input_tokens=65536.
GET /v1/models shows vllm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4 with ctx=131072 and max_in=98304 (no longer 147456/114688).
The esnixi vllm.nix and vllm-switch.py are UNCHANGED (B is an OmniRoute-side override fix).

curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT" https://omniroute.celestium.life/v1/models | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);[print(m['id'],m.get('context_length'),m.get('max_input_tokens')) for m in d['data'] if m['id'].startswith('vllm/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4')]" — expect 131072/98304.
